sloka: ततो विस्फारयामास महद्धनुरवस्थितः।उत्ससर्ज च तीक्ष्णाग्रान् राक्षसेषु महाशरान् ।। ६.९०.३ ।।
transliteration: tato visphārayāmāsa mahaddhanuravasthitaḥ।utsasarja ca tīkṣṇāgrān rākṣaseṣu mahāśarān ।। 6.90.3 ।।

translations.english: Then Vibheeshana stood with stretched bow and loosened sharp pointed arrows on Rakshasas.
